note: New entries are owner-only. Nick Hartman must state each skeleton. The default rule writes ie as y before dropping vowels. A standalone word of three letters or fewer is not shortened; a short part inside a compound still is. fried -> fryd comes from the ie rule and is not listed. The v3.19 eye -> 'y entry is superseded and removed. field -> f"ld and piece -> p"c are owner-stated. friend and science were given only as phonetics and are not listed. The double-quote marker is not a general default rule.
